name: Master in Management (MIM)
summary: Flagship European pre-experience graduate degree blending general management, economics, leadership, and international mobility.

roadmap.focus: Master core financial accounting, business statistics, microeconomics, and corporate strategy frameworks.
actions: Complete advanced Financial Modelling and valuation training in Excel/Python
Form cross-cultural case study teams and participate in European business competitions
Begin networking with campus alumni across Paris, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, and Milan

roadmap.focus: Electives in Digital Transformation, ESG & CSRD compliance, and Supply Chain Analytics.
actions: Secure competitive summer internship or gap-year placement in European enterprise
Achieve working proficiency (B2/C1) in target market local language (e.g. French, German)
Lead a pro-bono consulting assignment for a regional SME or green tech startup

roadmap.focus: Two 6-month corporate internships across distinct European industrial hubs.
actions: Internship 1: Strategy or Business Analytics in tech or automotive hub (Munich, Paris, Stockholm)
Internship 2: Operations or Product Management in high-growth scaleup or multinational
Synthesize real corporate challenges for Master's thesis topic

roadmap.focus: Defend research thesis and convert internships or campus interviews into permanent European contracts.
actions: Target European Graduate Trainee Programs and direct-entry Junior Analyst/Consultant roles
Leverage post-study visa frameworks (RECE in France, 18-month Job Seeker in Germany, Zoekjaar in NL)
Finalize onboarding with signed CDI / permanent employment offer

name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
summary: Post-experience executive management degree accelerating career switches into European corporate leadership, private equity, and enterprise strategy.

roadmap.focus: Macroeconomics, global operations, corporate valuation, and organizational behavior.
actions: Join industry professional clubs (Tech Club, Energy & Sustainability Club)
Define 3 target post-MBA industries in the European single market

roadmap.focus: Tailored electives in private equity, sustainable innovation, and global supply chains.
actions: Participate in corporate trek to Zurich, Amsterdam, and Berlin startup ecosystems
Interview for summer associate positions with European corporate development teams

roadmap.focus: Real-world consulting capstone project with European multinational sponsor.
actions: Negotiate European employment package including relocation and work permit sponsorship
Form alumni angel syndicates and strategic advisory networks

name: MSc Mechanical Engineering
summary: Advanced engineering degree specializing in structural mechanics, thermal dynamics, finite element simulation, and sustainable automotive/aerospace systems.

roadmap.focus: Nonlinear FEA, continuum mechanics, fluid-structure interaction, and materials science.
actions: Complete hands-on CAD/FEA simulation laboratory projects in CATIA and ANSYS
Apply for industrial thesis (Masterarbeit) with European aerospace or automotive OEMs

roadmap.focus: 6-month embedded thesis within an R&D department (Airbus, BMW, Siemens).
actions: Publish thesis findings on lightweight structural composites or battery pack cooling
Transition directly from thesis work into full-time mechanical systems engineering role

name: MSc Robotics & Autonomous Systems
summary: Interdisciplinary program fusing mechanical mechatronics, computer vision, kinematic control theory, and mobile robotics.

roadmap.focus: State estimation, Kalman filtering, ROS 2 middleware, and neural visual perception.
actions: Deploy navigation stack on physical mobile robot platforms in university robotics lab
Collaborate on European robotics competition or research consortium grant

roadmap.focus: Industrial automation internship at ABB, KUKA, or automotive assembly hub.
actions: Validate SLAM mapping algorithms under challenging factory lighting conditions
Secure robotics development engineering position with European robotics integrator

name: MSc Data Science & AI
summary: Rigorous mathematics, statistical machine learning, deep neural architectures, and distributed high-performance computing.

roadmap.focus: Stochastic processes, high-dimensional statistics, PyTorch, and distributed training.
actions: Implement end-to-end transformer architectures and fine-tune on domain datasets
Audit algorithms against EU AI Act risk categorization guidelines

roadmap.focus: Deploy ML pipelines into cloud production environments with automated monitoring.
actions: Conduct industrial research thesis on predictive maintenance or multi-modal vision
Interview for AI/ML Engineer and Data Scientist roles across European tech centers

name: MSc Finance
summary: Quantitative corporate finance, asset pricing, derivatives valuation, fintech platforms, and European sustainable finance regulations.

roadmap.focus: Econometrics, fixed income mathematics, Bloomberg terminal certification, and Python for finance.
actions: Compete in European university valuation and equity research challenges
Pass CFA Level I examination during winter study term

roadmap.focus: EU Taxonomy for sustainable finance, ESG green bond structuring, and private equity.
actions: Complete off-cycle internship in Frankfurt, Paris, or Amsterdam banking district
Secure full-time role in corporate financial planning, consulting, or investment management

name: MSc Marketing & Brand Management
summary: Consumer behavioral psychology, luxury omnichannel strategy, data-driven customer acquisition, and European brand equity.

roadmap.focus: Brand architecture, digital marketing funnels, customer analytics, and storytelling.
actions: Conduct ethnographic research and consumer sentiment analysis in Milan or Paris
Build multi-touch attribution dashboards linking marketing spend to conversions

roadmap.focus: Luxury heritage marketing, sustainable brand positioning, and thesis defense.
actions: Work with European luxury or consumer goods house on international product launch
Transition into Junior Brand Manager or Marketing Strategist permanent role

name: MSc Supply Chain & Logistics
summary: Global network optimization, trans-European multimodal freight corridors, green procurement, and automated warehouse operations.

roadmap.focus: Inventory theory, network simulation, SAP S/4HANA supply chain modules, and supplier risk.
actions: Tour high-throughput distribution hubs in Rotterdam, Antwerp, or Frankfurt Airport
Obtain APICS / CSCP professional foundational certification

roadmap.focus: Decarbonizing freight networks, Scope 3 supply chain auditing, and industry thesis.
actions: Execute supply chain resilience audit for European manufacturing partner
Join pan-European logistics or automotive OEM supply chain development program
